articles.title: Solana, Sui and Aptos wallet data targeted in TrapDoor package attack
articles.snippet: The campaign targets crypto, DeFi, AI and security developers with fake tooling packages to steal wallets, SSH keys, GitHub tokens, cloud credentials and browser data.

articles.title: Crypto trading firm FalconX confidentially files with SEC for IPO, hires bankers
articles.snippet: FalconX has hired Cantor and other bankers to advise on a potential IPO and confidentially filed draft paperwork with the SEC, though the listing is not expected until later this year amid volatile market conditions.

articles.title: What the Clarity Act Means for the Rest of the World
articles.snippet: The Senate’s crypto bill has supporters excited—and opponents concerned—about the bill’s potential reverberations beyond America’s borders.
